description: North Western Province - Notifying that the Provincial Council of North Western Province has approved the By-laws relating to Pradeshiya Sabhas Published in Gaz.Ex.ord. No. 1930/06 of 31.08.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the approval of by-laws for local authorities (Pradeshiya Sabhas) regarding the administration of crematoriums, regulation of florists, committee meetings, and fee collection. This falls under the establishment of regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements, which is characteristic of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it involves provincial government action, the core content is about creating local regulations rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganization.
